title: reserved-pool-oversubscription-hotfix-and-customer-communications
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Multiple Reserved Pool customers experienced transient capacity shortfalls and elevated 429/503 errors during high burst windows. Root cause was a logic error in the Dedicated autoscaler that double-counted inflight allocation units when prefix/KV cache hits reduced token emission, causing the autoscaler to undersize pools and permit oversubscription during routing bursts. This ticket tracks the hotfix, mitigations, customer communications, and follow-up actions.
acceptance_criteria: Autoscaler inflight accounting corrected in staging and validated with synthetic burst test
Hotfix deployed to canary and then prod without regression to latency SLOs
Affected customers have received incident summary and postmortem timeline
Runbook updated with new mitigation steps and escalation path
Unit + integration tests added to prevent regression of inflight counters
resolution_summary: Fixed an off-by-one aggregation bug in the reserved-pool autoscaler that double-counted in-flight slots when KV cache compacted requests; applied a tactical capacity bump + throttling policy for impacted pools; rolled out runtime-1.23 with the corrected autoscaler and added deterministic e2e load tests. Customer communications completed and runbook updated.
comments: 2026-03-01 09:12 - Aisha Patel: Pager alerted on multiple 429 spikes for reserved pools in us-west-2. Initial hypothesis: burst routing misconfigured or burst limit exhaustion. Opening ticket to coordinate mitigation.

2026-03-01 09:35 - Diego Marquez: Correlated spikes with a batch of long-short chat requests from Partner A. Autoscaler logs show a rapid drop in 'available_slots' counter without corresponding node terminations.

2026-03-01 10:05 - Natasha Kim (oncall): Applied temporary per-customer burst throttle (limit reduced by 30%) to affected pools which reduced error rate; created a capacity increase request to platform to allocate spare nodes to the reserved pools.

2026-03-01 14:20 - Diego Marquez: Reproduced locally: when KV cache hits compress output token counts, our inflight estimation used emitted token estimates instead of original request token budget causing double-count when both counters were added. Created a patch to compute inflight as max(emitted_estimate, request_budget) and to surface a safety margin factor.
2026-03-02 08:50 - SRE Team: Provisioned +15% temporary GPUs to affected pools to relieve customer impact; monitored 3 hours, error rate returned to baseline.
2026-03-03 11:12 - Diego Marquez: PR opened for autoscaler fix. Added unit tests for counter math and an integration harness that simulates mixed cached/uncached request profiles.

2026-03-04 16:00 - Product (Marco Ruiz): Drafted customer-facing message for impacted accounts. Prioritized transparency: timeline, root cause, immediate mitigations, and committed timeline for runbook and tests.
2026-03-05 09:30 - Support: Sent initial notification to affected customers with temporary mitigation steps and ETA for full fix. One customer escalated to legal — CC'd Trust & Safety.

2026-03-07 02:40 - Diego Marquez: Deployed fix to canary; smoke tests passed. No latency regression observed in 95/99th percentiles. Scheduled prod rollout during low-traffic window 2026-03-07 04:00 UTC.
2026-03-07 06:15 - SRE: Prod rollout completed. Autoscaler metrics show corrected inflight counts and stable scaling decisions. Observed smooth ramp during simulated burst replay.
2026-03-08 10:00 - Aisha Patel: Customer follow-ups: three customers confirmed service returned to normal; one requested write-up for compliance and audit — provided incident doc.

2026-03-09 15:20 - Diego Marquez: Post-deploy: added deterministic e2e tests into CI that run a cached/uncached mixed workload profile every night; added a guardrail in autoscaler that refuses negative free_slot signals and emits alert when inflight_ratio > 0.85.

2026-03-11 09:00 - Product (Marco Ruiz): Shared postmortem with sales and solutions teams, included commitments: add per-customer burst headroom controls in Console and update SLA language for reserved pools.

2026-03-12 12:00 - Aisha Patel: Closing ticket. Action items created for next cycle: ENG-20410 (console UI for per-pool burst headroom), ENG-20411 (quota dashboard for customers), ENG-20412 (runbook tabletop exercises).
